CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trip_cancellation_receipt_json_v1(r trip_activity_cancellation_receipts)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('contract', 'vinetrack.trip-activity-cancellation', 'schemaVersion', 1, 'status', r.status, 'operation_id', r.operation_id, 'trip_id', r.trip_id, 'vineyard_id', r.vineyard_id, 'application_classification', r.application_classification, 'compliance_archive_id', r.compliance_archive_id, 'spray_record_ids', to_jsonb(r.spray_record_ids), 'removed_counts', r.removed_counts, 'server_revision', r.server_revision, 'cancelled_at', r.cancelled_at);
$function$

functions.name: vineyard_role
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vineyard_role(p_vineyard_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select vm.role
  from public.vineyard_members vm
  where vm.vineyard_id = p_vineyard_id
    and vm.user_id = auth.uid()
  limit 1;
$function$
